Handed to the team · A free Power Kit is compensation only Georges approves; code already issued.

Hi Razvan,

Thank you for staying with us, that means a lot.

Your Thor P2 on Shop···· is kept as it is and ships no later than October 29, from our Netherlands warehouse, so nothing extra is payable on delivery. The batch is on its way to us now and you can follow it here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

On the coupon, I have issued the one we promised you anyway, so you have it in hand: HD-••••••, $25 off your next order, yours alone, valid on orders over $100.

On the EU Power Kit as a gift, that one is not mine to approve, so I have put it in front of a colleague with your order. They are offline this evening and pick it up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and you will get their answer by email, no need to write again.

Have a great day, Razvan.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
